context:
Goal: testers and agents know which database tests and approvals use, now that Neon branch wt-main is gone.
Problem (rule): q_max D-757 (wt-main is the one database testers share) puts all test data and approvals in Neon branch wt-main. That branch was deleted today, and D-827 says no session touches Neon, so the ruling cannot hold. Only your new ruling may change it.
Based on (read): the Neon cleanup session (session_013NEJL3qxP6GqXNGS7bixMo) deleted 113 wt- branches; only production and live-backup-2026-10-02 remain.
Based on (read): q_max data/ux-seed holds a wt-main dump from 2026-10-01 (93 jobs, 7,422 approvals); harness/data/load.mjs loads it into a local database.
Based on (ruling): q_max D-827, a session never touches Neon.
Departs from: main D-757 (testers share Neon wt-main) — retire it, or name a new shared database.
Meanwhile: lane qmax-d757-wt-main-stale (session_013NEJL1kqjrZZqdqpz3eaGB) waits; nothing else depends on it.

options.gain: Matches D-827, and a session can run it. Tests seed from data/ux-seed. Approvals that matter go into production by your hand. Debt e7-no-wt-main-migration-step closes.
options.label: Retire D-757: each worktree tests on its own local database
options.lose: No live shared test data, and the seed dates from 2026-10-01.

options.gain: One current, shared data set for human testers.
options.label: You make a new shared Neon branch from production, and D-757 names it
options.lose: No session can reach it (D-827), and the migration-step debt stays open.

options.label: Production becomes the shared test database
